exact_reference_identity.patch_rule: SWAP-001 is the only admitted B0->B1 patch touching macropore.f90; no later B1 patch changes macropore/macrorate semantics.

fpe16.use: corroborated ownership/state-layout evidence, not a byte-level B1.11 source oracle

fpe15.use: corroborated execution-scratch evidence, not full macropore thread-safety authority

fsi15.use: current architecture precedent: explicit macropore option with active route fail-closed

state_classification.candidate_basis: F-PE16 repository evidence recovered from exact historical S12 artifacts; exact B1.11 byte source is still required before these names become final migration authority.
trial_mutation_warning: F-PE16 reports SorpDmCp and ThtSrpRefDmCp as trial-mutable under the historical line.
A future candidate must prove complete rollback coverage for every source-traced trial-mutable committed/history field.

worker_scratch.rule: recomputable macrorate/SATFLOW/ABSORPTION/RAPIDDRAIN workspace must not be checkpoint state
worker_scratch.evidence: F-PE15 proves an extracted helper-scratch subset can be explicit worker/job scratch with exact output preservation; F-PE16 describes a broader S12r scratch design but lacks independent executable qualification.

output_and_diagnostics.rule: reporting/cumulative output state is not commit authority unless exact B1.11 source trace proves physical continuation semantics.

invariants: matrix<->macropore exchange is an internal transfer and cancels from whole-column accepted mass when booked consistently
macropore storage change is physical storage and belongs in accepted state/mass reconciliation
external top, bottom, drainage and root-related water transfers are booked exactly once by one owner
gross matrix and macropore partition terms may not be double-counted as independent external fluxes
rejected trials produce no accepted macropore mass receipt

transaction_contract.checkpoint: all source-traced committed/history macropore state at accepted boundary
transaction_contract.trial: candidate state only; scratch is worker-local and disposable
transaction_contract.reject: restore all committed/history fields exactly; discard candidate mass receipts and scratch
transaction_contract.retry: recompute from same committed macropore+matrix checkpoint under the new numerical span
transaction_contract.commit: publish macropore state delta and external mass receipts atomically with the accepted Richards interval

restart_contract.topology: new explicit optional macropore state layout required before production
restart_contract.payload_rule: persist only source-proven continuation state, never worker scratch
restart_contract.reconstruction_rule: a field may be omitted from restart only after source-bound proof that it is deterministic from accepted state/configuration

perform complete cross-call mutable-field and mass-transfer source census
freeze exact restart schema and candidate/scratch split

later_slices.scope: byte-exact B1.11 source materialization and mutable-field census
typed macropore committed/candidate/restart state DTOs and rollback harness, no flow equations
single-column macropore process/rate migration against exact source oracle
full runtime composition with hard mass, restart and current-path preservation
